````markdown --- title: "Practical Machine Learning Project" author: "Sharif Ahmed" output: html_document --- ## Background The goal is to predict the manner in which participants performed the exercise using accelerometer measurements. ```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE} library(caret) library(randomForest) ``` ## Load Data ```{r} train <- read.csv( "https://d396qusza40orc.cloudfront.net/predmachlearn/pml-training.csv", na.strings = c("NA","","#DIV/0!") ) ``` ## Data Cleaning ```{r} train <- train[, colSums(is.na(train)) == 0] train <- train[, -(1:7)] train$classe <- as.factor(train$classe) train <- na.omit(train) ``` ## Partition Data ```{r} set.seed(12345) inTrain <- createDataPartition( train$classe, p = 0.7, list = FALSE ) training <- train[inTrain, ] validation <- train[-inTrain, ] ``` ## Build Random Forest Model ```{r} set.seed(12345) modelRF <- randomForest( classe ~ ., data = training, ntree = 50 ) ``` ## Conclusion A Random Forest model was trained to predict exercise performance classes using accelerometer measurements
